day_shape: 92 items: joint Iran-Russia-China statement rejecting IAEA inspection resumption, IDF ground operation beyond Gaza's Yellow Line to destroy a tunnel, Houthi missile salvo on Riyadh airport and financial centre, US Treasury sanctions on Hezbollah front Wa Ta'awanu Association, CENTCOM chief Cooper in Israel, three tankers struck by mines east of Hormuz per Iran's army.

threads.label: Iran, Russia, China reject IAEA inspections
threads.summary: Iran, Russia and China issued a joint statement saying resumption of IAEA inspections at Iranian nuclear sites is only possible after complete cessation of military action and removal of threats. Iran's Vienna mission and Defa Press echoed that US and Israeli threats make normal safeguards implementation impossible; IAEA chief Grossi separately praised inspection terms in a planned US-Saudi nuclear deal.

threads.label: IDF operation beyond Gaza Yellow Line
threads.summary: The IDF confirmed a ground operation west of the Yellow Line in central Gaza to demolish a Hamas tunnel, with evacuation orders issued for Bureij and Nuseirat blocks. The Jerusalem Post reported IDF tanks advanced into Hamas-controlled territory for the first time since the October 2025 ceasefire; Hamas and Yemen's foreign ministry called the movements a ceasefire violation.

threads.label: Houthi strikes on Riyadh, Saudi exchanges
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Sareea announced cruise-missile strikes on King Khalid International Airport and Riyadh's Financial Centre; Saudi civil defence later said the danger in southern cities had passed. Defa Press said Saudi forces carried out 87 air and missile attacks on Yemen in 24 hours using F-15 and Typhoon jets; UNICEF reported at least 64 children killed in Yemen since 3 September.

threads.label: CENTCOM chief Cooper in Israel
threads.summary: CENTCOM commander Adm. Brad Cooper arrived in Israel for meetings with IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir and Mossad director Roman Gofman focused on the Iranian threat. CENTCOM also denied online claims of US personnel injured in Iranian attacks this week; the Jerusalem Post reported Mossad chief advocated strikes on Iran while Gulf leaders urged Trump against an attack.

threads.label: US sanctions Hezbollah front network
threads.summary: The State Department and Treasury announced sanctions against the Wa Ta'awanu Association, a Hezbollah-affiliated front claiming to deliver relief in southern Lebanon, along with its founder and two brothers accused of aiding Hezbollah. Jerusalem Post carried the Treasury designation.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: Iran's army said three smuggling tankers transiting the prohibited zone east of the Strait of Hormuz with navigation systems off struck sea mines and caught fire. Army spokesman Amir Akraminia said control of the Strait remains in the hands of Iran's armed forces, with monitoring increased.

threads.label: Iran retaliation rhetoric and alleged plots
threads.summary: Iran's Foreign Ministry warned that US use of regional countries' territory justifies Iran's right to defence, and Iran International reported Tehran seizing on an NYT dam report to widen retaliation threats. Separately, Jerusalem Post reported IRGC directed Hezbollah to recruit six Thai nationals for an attack on Israel's Bangkok embassy, a 27-year sentence for Pakistani Asif Merchant over an Iran-linked assassination plot, and acknowledged Iranian cyber activity against US infrastructure.

events.title_en: Statement by Iran, Russia and China: Agency inspections only possible after complete cessation of war
events.summary_en: Statement by Iran, Russia and China: Agency inspections only possible after complete cessation of war. Iran, Russia and China on Wednesday issued a statement rejecting military aggression against Iran and emphasised that resumption of inspections of Iran's nuclear facilities is only possible with complete cessation of military action, removal of all threats regarding resumption of aggression, and provision of convincing guarantees against repetition of such attacks and threats. The three countries stressed that insistence without conditions on implementing the safeguards mechanism without taking into account objective obstacles arising from aggressive acts does not contribute to full resumption of the Agency's verification activities in Iran.

events.summary_en: Holding of a commemorative session for Grand Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani by the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution in Mashhad and Qom. A condolence and commemorative session for the esteemed source of authority, Grand Ayatollah Vahid Khorasani, will be held tomorrow evening (Thursday 28 Aban) on behalf of the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Revolution, after the Maghrib and Isha prayers in the portico of Imam Khomeini in the Holy Shrine of Imam Reza in Mashhad.
